data.value: The river starts on an example year: replace its amounts with yours, or clear the company's figures to start at your pay.

data.name: RunningCostsLabel
data.value: Running costs, excluding VAT and your pay

data.name: Skipped
data.value: Skipped: no company figures, so the river starts at your pay.

data.name: RunningCostsHint
data.value: Leave out what Netto counts itself: your pay, INASTI's yearly company contribution, and whatever you add on another card of your plan: vouchers, expense allowances, home office rent, a company car's costs, a copyright royalty. Left in, it counts twice.

data.name: Help_Contribution
data.value: What every company pays INASTI each year, whatever it pays you: {0} while the balance-sheet total of its penultimate closed financial year is at most {1}, {2} above it. The company deducts it, like its running costs.

data.name: BalanceSheetHint
data.value: Your company's balance-sheet total of its penultimate closed financial year, as it stood on 1 January, sets which of INASTI's two company contributions it owes for {0}. A bill pending in the Chamber may change the {0} amounts retroactively; Netto applies the law in force.

data.name: BandHint
data.value: Exempt: a société de personnes in its first three years whose managers and most active partners were self-employed for at most 12 of the 40 quarters before it was formed, or a company with no activity for a whole calendar year, on an attestation of the SPF Finances, owes no contribution.
